notes:
A fix for the Framework freezing as it opens.

- **No more freeze on start.** The Network map gives each item its own id, adding "-2" to one that's taken. Once an id reached 40 characters, adding "-2" and cutting it back to 40 changed nothing, so it looped forever. A tailnet with many peers of the same name froze the app before its window could draw. Now it counts up (-2, -3…) within 40 characters.
- **Funnel's relays are left off the map.** A tailnet using Tailscale Funnel lists Tailscale's own ingress relays as peers, often dozens, all called funnel-ingress-node. They aren't your devices, so the map leaves them out.
- `desktop/` is still the Desktop App's 1.60.
